title: How 11x Automates Prospect Research for AI-Powered Outbound
summary: 11x uses Firecrawl's /crawl and /search to build company research briefs for AI-powered outbound, from each company's own site to sources across the web.
body_markdown:
*11x uses Firecrawl to build company research briefs for outbound workflows. To date, it has processed more than 11 million requests across 175,000 unique domains.*


**What is 11x?**[11x](https://www.11x.ai/) is an AI growth platform used by revenue teams at companies like Checkr, Rho, and Xerox. The platform automates GTM workflows across the full outbound cycle, from identifying and researching prospects to personalizing outreach and booking meetings, helping teams accelerate pipeline.


> Firecrawl gathers and structures information from across the web to give us a detailed picture of any company, from its position in the market down to the tools in its tech stack. That depth of research is what makes our outbound so context-rich.


*—[Jeson Patel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jepatel) , CTO at 11x*


## 11x's outbound automation starts with prospect research


For outbound to feel relevant, 11x needs to understand what each company sells, the problems it solves, its customer proof, and its brand identity.[Firecrawl](https://www.firecrawl.dev/) gathers and structures all of that information into research briefs the platform uses to tailor its outbound messages.


## Firecrawl brings company context together from across the web


Most of 11x's Firecrawl usage runs through[/crawl](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/crawl) , which goes deep on an identified company's website by following its sitemap and internal links.[/search](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/search) complements that site-level research by finding sources elsewhere on the web, including customer case studies, partnership announcements, and company facts such as headcount or headquarters.


11x has processed more than 11 million requests across 175,000 unique domains with Firecrawl, giving the platform deep company context at scale. By automating repetitive GTM work like prospect research, 11x gives revenue teams more time for the human side of sales: building trust and closing deals.
